name: MT8 Bisonte, electric 4WD estimate
description: Simulation-only estimated electric 4WD baseline scaled from the delivered MT8 blockout geometry. Mass, inertia, suspension, tire, drivetrain, and servo values are estimates, not measured vehicle data.

geometry_source.rights_status: User confirmed the supplied model and scripts may be included and modified; original source paths and hashes remain recorded.

sprung_mass_kg.source: Engineering estimate for an electric 4WD simulation baseline; no physical weighing, spring, tire, torque, or handling measurements were supplied.

unsprung_mass_kg.source: Engineering estimate for an electric 4WD simulation baseline; no physical weighing, spring, tire, torque, or handling measurements were supplied. Per wheel; includes wheel-end hardware estimate.

sprung_inertia_kg_m2.source: Engineering estimate for an electric 4WD simulation baseline; no physical weighing, spring, tire, torque, or handling measurements were supplied. Symmetric entries [Jxx,Jyy,Jzz,Jxy,Jxz,Jyz] about sprung CG, using the delivered chassis/body envelope as a scale reference.

wheel_spin_inertia_kg_m2.source: Engineering estimate for an electric 4WD simulation baseline; no physical weighing, spring, tire, torque, or handling measurements were supplied. Per wheel; wheel-end spin inertia placeholder.

drive_torque_per_wheel_nm.source: Engineering estimate for an electric 4WD simulation baseline; no physical weighing, spring, tire, torque, or handling measurements were supplied. Equal-torque electric 4WD approximation; RCV drive revision raises stall torque from 3.0 to 4.2 Nm per wheel. See docs/research/rc-monster-truck/RCV-drive/README.md.

brake_torque_per_wheel_nm.source: Engineering estimate for an electric 4WD simulation baseline; no physical weighing, spring, tire, torque, or handling measurements were supplied. RCV drive revision tunes maximum brake torque to the faster drivetrain; the previous 6.0 Nm estimate caused forward pitch-over during full braking near 10 m/s. See docs/research/rc-monster-truck/RCV-drive/README.md.

drive_torque_fade_rad_s.source: Engineering estimate for an electric 4WD simulation baseline; no physical weighing, spring, tire, torque, or handling measurements were supplied. Linear torque fade reaches zero at this wheel speed; 0.100 m tires imply 10 m/s unloaded rolling speed. This is not a measured motor curve, battery model or guaranteed road speed.
